newsitem.title: USA: First day of new CME milk contract uneventful.
newsitem.headline: First day of new CME milk contract uneventful.

text.p: The first day of trading in the new CME basis formula price (BFP) milk futures saw no trades and only few bids and offers.

Trading got off to a slow start despite exchange expectations the new cash settled contract would attract more interest from the dairy industry than the previous physically delivered fluid milk contract did.
July was bid at 11.31 cents per lb and offered at 11.75 cents. August had no bids or offers and September ranged widely at 12.40 bid, 15.00 asked.
